site.reason: Python ints have unlimited precision; Java int and long arithmetic wraps silently on overflow (1000000 * 1000000 as an int is -727379968).

flags.reasoning: Because s *= q multiplies input values repeatedly while s < t, values can overflow Java's 32-bit int even for moderate inputs such as t = 100000, s = 50000, q = 50000 (where s * q wraps to -1794967296 in Java instead of 2500000000 in Python, failing to exit the loop after one iteration). Using BigInteger preserves Python's arbitrary-precision arithmetic.
